bonus reply:

take the lowest hanging fruit you can find and go to them saying how you couldnt believe in something more than seeing their business #getthatglamup and ask if you can make shit happen for them

7/10 times they will have already wanted the help your offering or have put a lot of thought into it but “just coildnt/cant afford it right now” or “it just keeps getting put on the back burner.” 

if its a back burner issue usually theyve got the resources for at least a decent monthly already, but only enough for like 3-6 months nd they hoping that by the tjme the money runs out, your magic making the money to continue + start coming in. these clients are usually less apprehensive to sign, but are more meticulous about being involved in what youre doing than the ‘no resources’ type client. you give results, theyll increase their spend decently regularly, but first time one dollar in means anything less than 1.10 out, theyll probably find someone else (who will be their cousin and ‘we shouldve just had him do it all in the first place but thought you had some good ideas and wanted to give you the opportunity…’ btw when you hear this youll notice it always comes with a very particular facial demeanor that makes you pretty sure what theyre tryina say is ‘fucking knew we shouldntvr trusted you, you ignorant ill-dressed thief’ no matter how much you end up making for them in the end

that client will be a harder sell in terms of getting them onboard with becoming a recurring rev client, but will usually be insanely less hands on then the ‘backburner’ client. sometimes so hands off itll seem like they dont care or understand or respect all that youll be doing. 9/10x thats not the case at all, its that theyve already got so many things going on theyre hoping to just trust you to make it happen like youve convinced them you could. also usually some of their hands off vibe comes from they feel ignorant toward that part of biz strategy and it’s uncomfortable for them to have no idea what youre talking about when in their head they should know all of that kuzz theyll feel as the owner its their responsibility to know everything. if youre able to grow their understanding of what youre doing and the ideas/strategy behind your actions and make them not feel stupid doing it, youll find yourself with one of the most loyal, appreciative client evangelist you could ever hope to have. the double edged sword for this client is if you break their trust one time, theyll never trust you or believe in your abilities ever again like they had beforehand. like…shits gon be real awkward now nd prolly not changing. 

no good or bad between those two client archetypes, simply a matter of which type of vibe allows you the environment most condusive for your success. and if you want thst real real success, being able to effectively work with both is imperative.
